description: Sign the user in to Show & Tell in this app, so every chat here plays as their account, with the same streak in any app they sign in from. Use it when the user asks to sign in, or to keep their streak in every chat. The app may show its own prompt to connect; when they're done, the call carries on. Pass the URL Show & Tell gave for this chat's round, so what they played here comes along.

platform.description: The assistant product you run in: "Claude", "ChatGPT", "Muse", "Grok", "Gemini", or another name.

url.description: The URL Show & Tell gave in this chat for the user's round, the one only they visit, so what they played here comes along. Pass it as is; don't visit it.

name: sign_in
title: Sign in to Show & Tell
